question: Nitu Ghangas won Gold in which sport at the Commonwealth Games 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Boxing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Nitu Ghangas is an Indian boxer who clinched the gold medal at the Commonwealth Games 2022.
 
• She competed in the Women's Minimumweight (45-48kg) category.
 
• Her victory is significant as it adds to India's prestigious history in boxing at the Commonwealth Games.
 
• Her achievement highlights the growing prominence of women in Indian sports, especially in traditionally male-dominated fields like boxing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonwealth Games:**

 
 
• The Commonwealth Games is an international multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The event was first held in 1930 and takes place every four years.
 
• It is one of the world's largest multi-sport events, showcasing a wide array of sports including athletics, boxing, swimming, and more.
 
• India has historically performed well in the Commonwealth Games, particularly in sports like weightlifting, shooting, wrestling, and boxing.
 
 
 
• **Boxing in India:**
 
 
• Boxing is a popular sport in India with a rich history, producing notable boxers like Mary Kom, Vijender Singh, and Amit Panghal.
 
• The Boxing Federation of India (BFI) is the governing body for the sport in India.
 
• Indian boxers have made significant strides on the international stage, earning medals in the Olympics, World Championships, and Commonwealth Games.
 
• The sport has seen increased support and investment in recent years, leading to improved facilities and training for athletes.
 
 
 
• **Women in Indian Sports:**
 
 
• Women in India have been increasingly making their mark in various sports, breaking stereotypes and achieving international success.
 
• Prominent female athletes include P.V. Sindhu (badminton), Mithali Raj (cricket), and Sania Mirza (tennis).
 
• Government initiatives and sponsorships have played a crucial role in promoting women's participation in sports.
 
• Success stories of female athletes have inspired many young girls to pursue careers in sports, contributing to a more inclusive sports culture in India.
